recipe.title: Apple cake
recipe.notes: This recipe comes from Jim Bolger, former Prime Minister, via a fundraising recipe book that Amy's mum had.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 180 deg C. Grease and flour a ring tin.

method.s: Sprinkle the sugar over the apple.
Add melted butter and egg, then dry ingredients - adding the raisins and walnuts last.
Pour into greased and floured ring tin.
Bake at 180 deg C for 40 minutes (50 minutes if not baked in a ring tin).
Once cooked, leave in the tin for 10-15 minutes before removing.
Dust with icing sugar and serve with yoghurt.
